factions.name: The Emberwatch
factions.blurb: The secret order the party is Emberbound to.

factions.name: The Miners' Guild
factions.blurb: Longsaddle's guild, headed by Tarn Suldaver.

factions.name: The Pale Lodge
factions.blurb: Hunters of false gods. Blue tabard, gold circle.

factions.name: House Vaelcrest
factions.blurb: Lord Edrion's house, holding Neverwinter against the Crown.

factions.name: House Crimson
factions.blurb: Creed's house and the party's original patrons.

quests.title: Audience at Castle Never
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, by Advocate Ineth Ravelle
quests.stakes: Edrion wants to meet the people who stood at the raw face in Griffon's Nest. Ravelle's written promises are pending: property, a liquor licence, unlimited Magistone with sharing, Carver's rights, and intel for Varsen. Handout: The Summons to Neverwinter.
quests.lead: Ravelle's writ puts the party on the next timber raft from Ashfoot Camp to Neverwinter's river gate.

quests.title: Cass Stormrider's Research
quests.stakes: Cass is testing the coloured stone, green among it.
quests.lead: Watch for one thing: whether being used on living things changes the stone itself.

quests.title: Creed's Ask
quests.stakes: Creed asked the party to end the compulsion.
quests.lead: Creed left with Kael.

quests.title: Dren Kolvar
quests.stakes: A professional bounty hunter with all their names on a list. The twins are worth a thousand apiece.
quests.lead: The bounties tripled. He may still be on their trail.

quests.title: Echoes of Brightfire
quests.stakes: Find out what happened to Creed's mother inside the sealed Brightfire Institute.
quests.lead: The vault opened and Corinne's fate was answered. Vaross is alive. The Pale Lodge coin went to Carver.

quests.title: Emberance
quests.lead: Completed.

quests.title: Hans's Amplifier
quests.stakes: Carver's amplifier for Hans.
quests.lead: Finished at sunrise and set on the table with a heavy thud.

quests.title: Hold for Onward: Facility 6
quests.stakes: Darion & Vasse ship Longsaddle's stone somewhere their manifests won't name. Harwick named Facility 6 and said Althin Vaross is alive and almost certainly running the research there.
quests.lead: Every manifest at Lisbeth Crane's bonded factor office reads 'hold for onward — F6'. The party believes the mountains Harwick meant are the ones in Moray.

quests.title: Lisbeth's Two Days
quests.stakes: Lisbeth Crane is waiting two days at her sister's.
quests.lead: She has a job lined up at Ze Flonti Flaggen.

quests.title: Onotaro's Hat
quests.stakes: The hat.
quests.lead: Won from the Vestarian Daughters.

quests.title: Operation Castle Shadow
quests.stakes: Take the Dawngate District and get beneath the palace.
quests.lead: General Althorn taken down at Dawngate. The party went under the palace through the north storm culvert.

quests.title: Operation Enduring Flesh
quests.stakes: Find out what the Crown was running beneath the grain mill in the Lower City.
quests.lead: Facility 9 cleared and sealed. The Ashvain Concordance recovered. Seraph woke.

quests.title: Operation Gatefall
quests.stakes: Open Suzail's western gate before dawn.
quests.lead: Captured Crimson soldiers freed and armed from the armory, the Radiant Frame destroyed, Commander Holst broken. The western gate fell.

quests.title: Operation High Tower
quests.stakes: Clear the Moon Tower and the throne room.
quests.lead: The tower cleared, its prisoner freed, the throne room taken. The Cormyrian Civil War ended.

quests.title: Seraph
quests.stakes: Seraph woke in Facility 9. Handout: Project: Seraph – Player Facing.
quests.lead: Harwick said it was charged from a relic holding a piece of Bast, killed nearly everyone at its trials, and may still sit beneath Suzail.

quests.title: Taking Griffon's Nest
quests.stakes: Take the Nest from Darion & Vasse.
quests.lead: Griffon's Nest was taken by midnight.

quests.title: The Banquet
quests.stakes: Get out of Suzail alive.
quests.lead: Escaped.

quests.title: The Bloodtithe
quests.stakes: A weapon commissioned for Varsen.
quests.lead: The Bloodtithe was made for Varsen.

quests.title: The Cobalt Covenant
quests.stakes: A grand kobold conspiracy in Suzail's undercity. Allegedly.
quests.lead: 'Eastern wharf. The 29th. Come alone.' Nobody went, and the date has passed.

quests.title: The Covenant of Dusk
quests.stakes: In the cave below Secumber five cultists stabbed themselves to feed the statue, and the Unlit came out of it. The party put it down and kept the green mote it left behind. Handout: The Quiet Codex — The First Verse (Of Noise).
quests.lead: The lead cultist carried a pamphlet ending 'The world will not end. It will exhale.' The sixth man bore the Covenant's mark behind his left ear and the first chapter of a credo in his coat.

quests.title: The Doctor Will See You Now
quests.stakes: Dr. Pell Harwick, a Facility Nine surgeon walking free in Baldur's Gate.
quests.lead: Found, interrogated under the zone and killed.

quests.title: The Frame under the Crag
quests.stakes: The Radiant Frame in Griffon's Nest is Carver's.

quests.title: The Green Harvest
quests.stakes: Something wrong in Secumber's harvest.
quests.lead: Secumber's stone returned to Hessa.

quests.title: The Grenholm Contract
quests.stakes: Find the Lodge's missing Pursuant. Norfinn Lake. The pay is one question and one true answer.
quests.lead: On completion, Carver gets his introduction to someone who can teach soul-splitting.

quests.title: The Griffon Tithe
quests.stakes: Someone poisoned the griffons.
quests.lead: Traced to the meat store with Cass's bloodhound.

quests.title: The Harpells' Ledgers
quests.stakes: Someone in Longsaddle has been writing the town down for the Crown.

quests.title: The Hush
quests.stakes: Nine people gone from the Lower City without a sound.
quests.lead: The banderhobbs were ended and the Flaming Fist paid out.

quests.title: The Longsaddle Charter
quests.stakes: House Vaelcrest wants Griffon's Nest. Longsaddle wants wages, protection and a say in what happens to it.
quests.lead: Signed at Feldryn's after eight hours of talks.

quests.title: The Neverwinter Hearth
quests.stakes: The Emberwatch keeps a hearth in Neverwinter. Handout: Emberwatch Field Ledger.

quests.title: The Ninth Life
quests.stakes: A house of the Cat Goddess, sealed and forgotten.
quests.lead: The Ninth Life recovered from the Reliquary of Bast.

quests.title: The Proving
quests.stakes: Each month the Collegium posts a question on the Proving Board in Neverwinter's Artificers' District, and every shop in the city competes to answer it.

quests.title: The Quiet One at Talfir
quests.stakes: A Pale Lodge contract on the Quiet One at Talfir.
quests.lead: Contract filled. The Lodge coins were notched.

quests.title: The Redeemer's Core
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, through Kael's deckhands
quests.stakes: Edrion's airship sits in a hidden hangar east of Neverwinter with nothing to power its engine. The stone from Griffon's Nest is meant for its reactor core.
quests.lead: The Nest is held. Its stone still has to reach the hangar east of Neverwinter.

quests.title: The Sealed North Shaft
quests.stakes: Nine men dug the sealed north section of the mine, and none of them came out right.
quests.lead: Done.

quests.title: The Stairwives
quests.stakes: The Stairwives, and what was hunting the poor quarters.
quests.lead: The party killed the banderhobb, uncovered the coven and told the Flaming Fist.

quests.title: The Steelwatch Waybill
quests.stakes: A wrecked caravan with a waybill for the Miners' Guild Hall in Longsaddle.
quests.lead: Delivered to Guildmaster Tarn Suldaver.

quests.title: The Vanished House
quests.stakes: House Ashvain vanished from its Starmantle estate in 1484 DR. No bodies, no struggle, no arcane trace. Handout: Ashvain Concordance.
quests.lead: Harwick said Adrion and Selise were being sent to Facility 6 when he last heard, 'but plans change.'

quests.title: Varsen's Sisters
quests.stakes: Varsen's sisters headed to Neverwinter to bid on prospecting claims in the Moonshaes and Tethyr.
quests.lead: The voice: 'She isn't the one I'm looking for… Keep the faith.'

quests.title: What Onotaro Lost
quests.stakes: Onotaro remembers nothing of who he was before he walked into Strike Team Four.
quests.lead: The Covenant's credo snagged on a life he can't get back to. A brass sun coin came with 'Answers will come soon. Stay the path.'

quests.title: Winning the Miners' Guild
quests.stakes: Bring Longsaddle's guild over to the party's side.
quests.lead: The Guild stands with the party.
